# harmoniq_approval_policy (Resource)

The approval policy of an environment: deploys, promotions, rollbacks and canary changes wait for approval. Don't combine with the `approval_policy` attribute of the same `harmoniq_environment`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "harmoniq_approval_policy" "staging" {
  workspace          = harmoniq_workspace.checkout_team.slug
  host_app           = harmoniq_host_app.storefront.slug
  environment        = harmoniq_environment.staging.slug
  required_approvers = 1
  eligible_roles     = ["developer", "admin", "owner"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `eligible_roles` (Set of String) Roles that may approve: `developer`, `admin`, `owner`.
- `environment` (String) Environment slug.
- `host_app` (String) Host app slug.
- `workspace` (String) Workspace slug.

### Optional

- `expiry_hours` (Number) Hours before a pending request expires (1–720, default 24).
- `require_change_ticket` (Boolean) Changes must carry a change ticket id.
- `required_approvers` (Number) Approvals needed (1–10, default 1). Requesters never approve their own changes.
- `ticket_url_pattern` (String) Link built from the ticket id, containing `{id}`, e.g. `https://acme.atlassian.net/browse/{id}`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) `workspace/host-app/environment`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import harmoniq_approval_policy.staging checkout-team/storefront/staging
```
